invocation.entrypoint: archive/cloudrun-backend/pronto-server-cloudrun.mjs (former HTTP service; Google Cloud Run live teardown is separately gated)

input_contract.description: Retired outward broker host. The current StoreApp no longer calls this service for payment verification, session state, native-plan recording, consent, repair start, report rendering, refunds, or AI-unavailable make-good.

output_contract.description: Historical JSON responses carried session state, recorded native plan ids, coupons, and server-rendered reports. Current repair reports are generated locally in StoreApp/LocalReport.cs.

observation_contract.description: Retired deployment record. The one-time paid Store app pivot removes the backend from the customer/reviewer critical path; the live service, if still present externally, is not current architecture authority.

evidence_contract.description: The former backend source is preserved in archive/cloudrun-backend. This archive move is source-level only and does not prove live Cloud Run deletion, Stripe deletion, Firestore deletion, or Secret Manager teardown.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: No current StoreApp behavior depends on this portal. Any live infrastructure teardown requires explicit owner approval and fresh evidence.
